name: Arty Cherry
source:
"A gentle breeze of hope that brings happiness!!"

She is a childhood friend of Nao and also a student at the magic academy. She has a calm and easy-going personality, but when the situation calls for it, she can show a strong-willed side of herself. She is the only person who became friends with Nao, forging a deep bond between them.

In the past, she and Nao were caught up in a magical disaster, and at that time, she awakened her magical abilities and saved him from a dire situation when he was fighting to protect her. However, as they were still young, they were unable to fully confront the monsters they were facing, ultimately being saved by a magical girl.

After entering the magic academy, they spent their days training their abilities together, and after a year she was able to transform into a magical girl. Since then, she has been involved in rescue activities for magical disasters and stopping terrorist activities by magic users.

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/ulU4C5k.jpeg]1st part of the official character description[/url]]

[spoiler]In the second work, she has been showing a proactive and strong curiosity side that was not seen before, surprising those around her. This can also be seen in her relationship with Nao, as she frequently launches love attacks on him without hesitation. Her elegant and clean appearance has also become more charming since she got together with Nao, causing many male students to feel jealous of him.

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/5fG0zmT.jpeg]2nd part of the official character description[/url][/spoiler]
